name: City of Davis Seasonal Lifeguard and Swim Instructor Jobs
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services (Aquatics)
what_you_do: As a lifeguard, you watch swimmers at city pools and help in emergencies. As a swim teacher, you teach kids in groups or one on one. You also enforce pool rules and help keep the pool clean and safe.
who_can_apply: Lifeguard: 15 or older. You must pass a swim skills test before you start. When hired, you need Red Cross Lifeguard Training with First Aid, CPR and AED. You also need First Aid for Public Safety (Title 22). Swim Instructor: 15 or older, or 14 if you did the city's Junior Swim Instructor class. You must be at ease in the water. You need some time spent with kids. Babysitting, tutoring, camp or volunteering counts.
pay_detail: 2026 rates: Lifeguard $17.83 to $18.27 per hour. Swim Instructor $16.97 to $17.39 per hour. Temporary part-time, no benefits.
duration: 2026 pool season: May 18 to September 7 for lifeguards. Swim lessons ran May 18 to August 16, 2026.
deadline_text: No aquatics job is posted as of Oct 16, 2026, and 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle: the Lifeguard (2026) and Swim Instructor (2026) postings both opened Jan 28, 2026. Lifeguard closed Apr 12, 2026 and Swim Instructor closed Apr 21, 2026. Expect new postings around late January 2027. A separate Off-Season Lifeguard posting ran Dec 3, 2024 to Jan 31, 2025.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the city's NEOGOV jobs page. Paper forms are not taken. If you get an interview, lifeguards must turn in their cards. The best fits get an interview, alone or in a small group. Everyone who applies hears back by email.
notes: 2026 mandatory trainings: lifeguards the weekend of May 16 and 17 and the week of June 15 to 18; swim instructors May 2 and 3 and June 15 to 18. You must be free on those dates to be considered. Lifeguard shifts fall between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m., any day of the week, and planned vacation is capped at 14 days and must be approved before summer. To get certified first, the city's Red Cross Lifeguard Training course needs you to be 15 by the last day of the course (summer 2026 fee $275, per the Summer 2026 RecGuide). The Off-Season Lifeguard job (fall to spring) needs weekday morning and noon availability. Paid work under 18 needs a California work permit.
